A1.justification: Both ten-page PDFs describe SurgBlood and BlooDet, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and references. Neither includes the supplementary materials it cites, limiting comparisons of supplementary evaluations, annotation agreement and implementation details.

before.justification: v3 reports original SurgBlood experiments, zero-shot HemoSet segmentation results, qualitative predictions and component ablations in Section 5 and Tables 2–7.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results and additionally reports a no-optical-flow condition in Table 7.

M1.justification: Sections 4–4.4 retain the same SAM 2 architecture, bidirectional guidance, optical-flow memory modeling, edge generator, losses and alternating optimization. The flow-disabled condition is an ablation, not a revision of BlooDet.

E1.justification: SurgBlood and HemoSet coverage is unchanged. Section 5.1 in v3 also names Rabbani and SUN-SEG supplementary evaluations; v4 mentions only Rabbani. Without the referenced supplements, it is unclear whether SUN-SEG evaluation was removed or only its main-text reference.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain the same 13 comparison methods and their dual-task or task-specific participation. The qualitative comparison also retains PAINet, PitSurgRT and SAM 2. Citation changes do not alter these comparator sets.

E3.justification: Table 7 adds an explicit no-optical-flow control to the reported comparison. Existing settings remain unchanged, including the 75/20 SurgBlood clip split, zero-shot HemoSet testing, eight-frame training inputs, 512×512 resolution, 20 epochs and evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: Table 7 now directly tests disabling optical flow alongside the retained global, foreground and background variants. Conversely, v3's Figure 6 camera-motion visualization is removed. The other displayed component, edge-generator and mutual-guidance analyses remain.

E5.justification: Tables 2–4 retain identical mean-plus-standard-deviation reporting, without added run or seed counts. v3's reference to inter-annotator agreement in Supp. H disappears in v4, but neither PDF contains that analysis, preventing verification of changes to its statistical reporting.

E6.justification: Table 7 adds PCK-2%, PCK-5% and PCK-10% results of 14.17, 45.47 and 77.10 for the no-optical-flow condition. Existing numerical results are unchanged, including BlooDet's 64.88 SurgBlood IoU and 83.69 PCK-10%. The qualitative motion example in v3 Figure 6 is removed.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 retain the same coupled objective, prompt definitions, optical-flow calculation, Gabor/Laplacian formulation and alternating updates. The mathematical reasoning is unchanged; equation spacing and extraction differences do not constitute theoretical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, four introductory contributions and conclusion retain the same claims: introducing SurgBlood, jointly detecting bleeding regions and points through BlooDet, and outperforming 13 comparison methods. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations of mutual guidance, background-flow stability and edge refinement are retained. The revised cross-branch sentence restates the existing mechanism. No substantive new limitation, applicability boundary or clinical qualification appears.

D1.justification: v3 states that code and data are available without providing an address; v4 adds an explicit SurgBlood GitHub URL in the abstract. The implementation settings remain unchanged. The removed reference to supplementary Algorithm 1 does not establish an implementation change.

R1.justification: Six references are added and six removed. Additions include topology-constrained and depth-induced liver-landmark work, OSFormer and CalibNet; removals include Medical SAM 2, the SUN-SEG paper, Fourier features and older landmark work. The surrounding research taxonomy and novelty positioning remain largely unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited sentence edits, shortens or removes supplementary cross-references, adds the corresponding author's email and introduces funding acknowledgements. The principal section order, terminology and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 Figure 6 is deleted, while Figures 7–9 become v4 Figures 6–8 with unchanged visual content. Table 7 gains a row. Equation spacing and text flow change, and page-number footers disappear; the overall two-column presentation remains.

improvement.justification: Within the supplied PDFs, the added Table 7 control strengthens evidence about optical flow's contribution, and the explicit code/data URL improves access information. These are modest gains despite losing v3's illustrative optical-flow figure. The method and main benchmark results remain unchanged. Missing supplements limit conclusions about appendix-dependent changes.
